newsitem.title: USA: US Soft-landing -- Has the Fed done it again?
newsitem.headline: US Soft-landing -- Has the Fed done it again?

text.p: After several months of anxiety and fear over an overheating economy, a batch of fresh data suggested on Tuesday that the U.S. may be poised for another soft landing, Wall Street pundits said.
But, they added, a few stumbling blocks remain before the Federal Reserve fully achieves its mission to keep inflation in check and economic growth at a sustainable pace between 2.0 and 2.5 percent.
Managing risks will be the hardest part.

Many see a soft-landing scenario as a central banker's nirvana. Still, some analysts said it is much like walking a tight rope since the odds may quickly swing from recession fears to inflationary pressures.
"The real risk of a soft-landing is that we're going to see situations when we bounce back and forth," said Christopher Low, senior economist at HSBC Markets Inc.
